content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I give, devise, and bequeath all my personal property, including but not limited to furniture, jewelry, and other tangible assets, to my son, Alexander J. Johnson, hereinafter referred to as 'he'.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I give, devise, and bequeath my real property located at 456 Elm Street, Maplewood City, to my daughter, Emily K. Johnson, hereinafter referred to as'she'.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Executor
content_blocks.text: I appoint my nephew, Benjamin P. Smith, as Executor of this Will, to manage the distribution of my estate and ensure that all provisions of this Will are carried out.
